citations.ref: GS1 General Specifications, "Check digit calculation" section
citations.claim: check digit of 0 36000 29145 must be 2, not 3
citations.evidence: GenSpecs 26.0 §7.9.1, Table 7-8 "Check digit algorithm": GTIN-12 positions N1..N11 weighted x3,x1,...,x3; "Subtract sum from nearest equal or higher multiple of ten = check digit". By hand for 03600029145: 3x(0+6+0+2+1+5)=42, +(3+0+0+9+4)=16, sum 58, 60-58 = 2.

citations.claim: product name, identity and net quantity must appear on PDP
citations.evidence: 21 CFR 101.1 defines the principal display panel of package-form food and says it "shall be large enough to accommodate all the mandatory label information"; the identity requirement is 101.3(a) ("The principal display panel ... shall bear ... a statement of the identity") and net quantity is 101.7.
21 CFR 101.5 "Food; name and place of business of manufacturer, packer, or distributor".
21 CFR 101.4(a)(1): ingredients "shall be listed by common or usual name in descending order of predominance by weight".
16 CFR Part 701 is "Disclosure of Written Consumer Product Warranty Terms and Conditions" (Magnuson-Moss); nothing on ingredient lists.
21 CFR 101.100 is "Food; exemptions from labeling" (e.g. (a) exemptions from ingredient declaration); the allergen declaration is FDCA 403(w), 21 USC 343(w).

answers.notes: Never examines the barcode. Cites a CFR section that no longer exists (101.105) and a warranty regulation (16 CFR 701) for cosmetic ingredients.
